easy: To put someone or something in a place where it could get hurt.

ex.en: Running across the road can endanger your life.
ex.ko: 도로를 뛰어서 건너면 목숨이 위험해질 수 있다.

easy: Liking an idea or a team so much that it is too much.

ex.en: The fanatic crowd cheered for the team for hours.
ex.ko: 열광적인 관중들은 몇 시간 동안 팀을 응원했다.

easy: A person who likes something so much that they think about nothing else.

ex.en: My brother is a soccer fanatic and talks about it all day.
ex.ko: 내 동생은 축구광이라서 하루 종일 축구 얘기만 한다.

easy: Computer instructions saved inside a machine so they stay even when it is turned off.

ex.en: The game controller needs new firmware to work well.
ex.ko: 게임 조종기가 잘 작동하려면 새 펌웨어가 필요하다.

easy: Having to do with the leader of a state.

ex.en: Our state will vote in the gubernatorial election this fall.
ex.ko: 우리 주는 올가을에 주지사 선거를 한다.

easy: A small tree or bush with spring flowers and little red berries.

ex.en: Bees buzzed around the hawthorn in bloom.
ex.ko: 벌들이 꽃이 핀 산사나무 주위에서 윙윙거렸다.

easy: A very big crowd.

ex.en: A horde of kids ran onto the playground at recess.
ex.ko: 쉬는 시간에 아이들 한 무리가 운동장으로 달려 나갔다.

easy: A soft, low sound that goes on and on.

ex.en: I heard the humming of the fridge in the quiet kitchen.
ex.ko: 조용한 부엌에서 냉장고가 웅웅거리는 소리가 들렸다.

easy: Making a tune with your mouth closed.

ex.en: Her humming made the whole car feel happy.
ex.ko: 그녀의 콧노래 덕분에 차 안이 온통 즐거워졌다.

easy: Burning because a fire was started.

ex.en: The ignited match lit the candle.
ex.ko: 불이 붙은 성냥이 초에 불을 밝혔다.

easy: Without any doubt or questions.

ex.en: I implicitly trust my best friend.
ex.ko: 나는 내 단짝 친구를 무조건 믿는다.

easy: Without saying it in words, but still meant.

ex.en: Dad stood at the door and implicitly told us it was time to go.
ex.ko: 아빠는 문 앞에 서서 말없이 이제 갈 시간이라고 알렸다.

easy: When things do not match or do not stay the same.

ex.en: Her story had an inconsistency: first it rained, then it was sunny all day.
ex.ko: 그 애 이야기에는 앞뒤가 맞지 않는 부분이 있었다. 처음엔 비가 왔다더니 하루 종일 맑았다고 했다.

easy: Being able to think up new and clever ideas.

ex.en: With great ingenuity, she built a boat from milk cartons.
ex.ko: 그녀는 뛰어난 창의력으로 우유갑으로 배를 만들었다.

easy: Being clever at finding new ways to do things.

ex.en: Everyone loved the ingenuity of his paper airplane.
ex.ko: 모두가 그의 종이비행기의 기발함을 좋아했다.

easy: Not made from living things. Rocks and metals are like this.

ex.en: Rocks and metal are inorganic things.
ex.ko: 바위와 금속은 무기물이다.

easy: Not alive, and never was alive.

ex.en: A rock is inorganic, but a tree is alive.
ex.ko: 바위는 무기물이지만 나무는 살아 있다.

easy: Keeping several balls in the air by throwing and catching them.

ex.en: He practiced juggling three oranges in the kitchen.
ex.ko: 그는 부엌에서 오렌지 세 개로 저글링을 연습했다.

easy: Made of lace, or looking like lace, a thin cloth with small holes in a pretty pattern.

ex.en: My little sister wore a lacy white dress to the party.
ex.ko: 내 여동생은 파티에 레이스가 달린 흰 드레스를 입고 갔다.

easy: Full of little holes, like a web.

ex.en: The frost made a lacy pattern on the window.
ex.ko: 서리가 창문에 그물 같은 무늬를 만들었다.

easy: The home of a wild animal.

ex.en: The fox slept in its lair under the tree.
ex.ko: 여우는 나무 밑 굴에서 잤다.

easy: Not alive anymore.

ex.en: We found a lifeless bird in the yard.
ex.ko: 우리는 마당에서 죽은 새 한 마리를 발견했다.

easy: With no living things in it.

ex.en: The moon is a lifeless place with no air or water.
ex.ko: 달은 공기도 물도 없는, 생명이 없는 곳이다.

easy: A line on the palm of your hand.

ex.en: She traced the lifeline on her palm with her finger.
ex.ko: 그녀는 손가락으로 손바닥의 생명선을 따라 그렸다.

easy: Something that helps you stay safe or keep going when you really need it.

ex.en: The phone was a lifeline when we got lost in the woods.
ex.ko: 숲에서 길을 잃었을 때 전화기는 생명줄이었다.

easy: Easy to love.

ex.en: Our lovable puppy follows me everywhere.
ex.ko: 사랑스러운 우리 강아지는 어디든 나를 따라온다.

easy: Something people can still argue about because no one is sure.

ex.en: Whether pizza is better than tacos is a moot question.
ex.ko: 피자가 타코보다 맛있는지는 논란의 여지가 있는 문제다.

easy: The study of the brain and the nerves that carry messages around the body.

ex.en: My aunt studies neurology to learn how the brain works.
ex.ko: 우리 이모는 뇌가 어떻게 작동하는지 알기 위해 신경학을 공부한다.

easy: A small animal with four legs and a long tail that lives near water.

ex.en: A tiny newt swam in the pond.
ex.ko: 작은 영원 한 마리가 연못에서 헤엄쳤다.

easy: Going over the land, not by sea or air.

ex.en: They made an overland trip across the country by car.
ex.ko: 그들은 차로 나라를 가로지르는 육로 여행을 했다.

easy: Old-time writing paper made from the skin of an animal.

ex.en: Long ago, people wrote letters on parchment.
ex.ko: 옛날 사람들은 양피지에 편지를 썼다.

easy: To take a share of something, like food.

ex.en: We all partook of the pizza at the party.
ex.ko: 우리 모두 파티에서 피자를 나눠 먹었다.

easy: Copying someone else's writing and saying it is your own.

ex.en: Copying a classmate's story is plagiarism.
ex.ko: 친구의 이야기를 베끼는 것은 표절이다.

easy: To watch students during a test so no one cheats.

ex.en: Our teacher proctored the math test.
ex.ko: 선생님이 수학 시험을 감독하셨다.

easy: A short part at the start of a play that tells you what is coming.

ex.en: The play began with a short prologue.
ex.ko: 연극은 짧은 프롤로그로 시작했다.

easy: To poke a hole in something with a sharp point.

ex.en: A nail punctured my bike tire.
ex.ko: 못이 내 자전거 타이어에 구멍을 냈다.

easy: To make a hole by poking through something.

ex.en: He punctured a small hole in the lid so the worm could breathe.
ex.ko: 그는 벌레가 숨 쉴 수 있도록 뚜껑에 작은 구멍을 뚫었다.

easy: A person with red hair.

ex.en: The redhead in my class has lots of freckles.
ex.ko: 우리 반 빨강 머리 친구는 주근깨가 많다.

easy: Someone who turns against their own group or friends.

ex.en: He left his team to join the rivals, and they called him a renegade.
ex.ko: 그가 팀을 떠나 상대 팀에 들어가자 모두 그를 배신자라고 불렀다.

easy: Things used to make the top of a house.

ex.en: The workers carried new roofing up the ladder.
ex.ko: 일꾼들이 새 지붕 재료를 사다리로 날랐다.

easy: Having to do with spinning around.

ex.en: A spinning top has rotational motion.
ex.ko: 팽이는 회전 운동을 한다.

easy: The frame that holds the glass of a window.

ex.en: The painter painted the window sash white.
ex.ko: 페인트공이 창틀을 흰색으로 칠했다.

easy: A long band of cloth tied around the waist.

ex.en: She tied a red sash around her waist.
ex.ko: 그녀는 허리에 빨간 띠를 둘렀다.

easy: A container you shake to mix or sprinkle something.

ex.en: Pass me the salt shaker, please.
ex.ko: 소금통 좀 건네줘.

easy: A track where cars or motorcycles race very fast.

ex.en: We watched race cars zoom around the speedway.
ex.ko: 우리는 경주용 자동차들이 경주장을 쌩쌩 달리는 것을 보았다.

easy: Having a long, sharp point.

ex.en: The cactus has spiked leaves.
ex.ko: 선인장은 뾰족한 가시 잎이 있다.

easy: Words at the bottom of a screen that show what people are saying.

ex.en: I read the Korean subtitles while watching the movie.
ex.ko: 나는 영화를 보면서 한국어 자막을 읽었다.

easy: A second title that tells more about a book.

ex.en: The book's subtitle explains what it is about.
ex.ko: 그 책의 부제는 책이 무엇에 관한 것인지 설명해 준다.

easy: Having spiral grooves, like a screw or bolt.

ex.en: A threaded bolt screws into the nut.
ex.ko: 나사산이 있는 볼트는 너트에 돌려 끼운다.

easy: An operation to put a body part from one person into another.

ex.en: A heart transplant gave the man a new chance at life.
ex.ko: 심장 이식은 그 남자에게 새 삶의 기회를 주었다.

easy: Digging up a plant and planting it in a new place.

ex.en: Moving the tomato plant to a bigger pot, a transplant, helped it grow.
ex.ko: 토마토 모종을 더 큰 화분으로 옮겨 심자 잘 자랐다.

easy: Adding pretty things to decorate something.

ex.en: We spent the evening on the trimming of the Christmas tree.
ex.ko: 우리는 저녁 내내 크리스마스트리를 장식했다.

easy: A pretty edge or extra piece added to clothes.

ex.en: The jacket has gold trimming on the sleeves.
ex.ko: 그 재킷은 소매에 금색 장식이 달려 있다.

easy: In a way that is honest and true.

ex.en: I truthfully told Mom that I broke the vase.
ex.ko: 나는 엄마에게 내가 꽃병을 깼다고 사실대로 말했다.

easy: Not something that matters much.

ex.en: The color of the pencil is unimportant, so just write.
ex.ko: 연필 색깔은 중요하지 않아. 그냥 써.

easy: Too small to matter.

ex.en: A tiny scratch is unimportant, so don't worry.
ex.ko: 작은 긁힘은 대수롭지 않으니 걱정하지 마.

easy: Good and honest in what you do.

ex.en: A virtuous girl returned the lost wallet.
ex.ko: 마음씨 바른 소녀가 잃어버린 지갑을 돌려주었다.

easy: A picture painted with watery paint.

ex.en: I hung my watercolor of the beach on the wall.
ex.ko: 나는 바닷가 수채화를 벽에 걸었다.

easy: Paint you mix with water to make soft colors.

ex.en: She dipped the brush in watercolor and painted the sky.
ex.ko: 그녀는 붓을 물감에 적셔 하늘을 칠했다.

easy: Rough, so it rubs and scrapes a surface.

ex.en: Sandpaper is abrasive, so it smooths wood.
ex.ko: 사포는 거칠어서 나무를 매끄럽게 문질러 준다.

easy: A person who helps someone do something wrong.

ex.en: The thief's accomplice waited outside in the car.
ex.ko: 도둑의 공범은 밖의 차 안에서 기다렸다.

easy: Being a parent or child by adoption, not by birth.

ex.en: Her adoptive parents love her very much.
ex.ko: 그 애의 양부모님은 그 애를 아주 많이 사랑한다.

easy: Put in the order of the letters A, B, C.

ex.en: Our names are in alphabetical order on the list.
ex.ko: 우리 이름은 명단에 알파벳순으로 적혀 있다.

easy: First one, then the other, again and again.

ex.en: I alternately hopped on my left and right foot.
ex.ko: 나는 왼발 오른발로 번갈아 깡충깡충 뛰었다.

easy: To wash your whole body.

ex.en: I bathe every night before bed.
ex.ko: 나는 매일 밤 자기 전에 목욕한다.

easy: To fill a place with light or color.

ex.en: The room was bathed in sunlight.
ex.ko: 방 안이 햇빛으로 가득 찼다.

easy: To put fizzy bubbles of gas into a drink.

ex.en: Soda is carbonated, so it fizzes.
ex.ko: 탄산음료는 탄산이 들어 있어서 보글보글 거품이 난다.

easy: A sweet cake made with soft cheese.

ex.en: We had strawberry cheesecake for Mom's birthday.
ex.ko: 엄마 생일에 딸기 치즈케이크를 먹었다.

easy: Sung by a group of people together.

ex.en: Our school's choral concert is on Friday.
ex.ko: 우리 학교 합창 공연은 금요일에 있다.

easy: A list of events in the order they happened.

ex.en: We made a chronology of our class trip, from the bus ride to the picnic.
ex.ko: 우리는 버스 타기부터 소풍까지 현장학습 일을 순서대로 정리한 연표를 만들었다.

easy: A sea animal that lives in sand or mud inside a hard shell.

ex.en: The clam closed its shell tightly when I touched it.
ex.ko: 내가 건드리자 조개는 껍데기를 꼭 닫았다.

easy: A man who is very good at making things with his hands.

ex.en: The craftsman carved a wooden bird.
ex.ko: 그 장인은 나무로 새를 조각했다.

easy: To hurt something so badly that it cannot work well.

ex.en: A big storm crippled the town's power.
ex.ko: 큰 폭풍이 마을의 전기를 마비시켰다.

easy: A bend or curve in something.

ex.en: The curvature of the banana makes it easy to hold.
ex.ko: 바나나는 휘어 있어서 잡기 쉽다.

easy: A person who has machine parts working inside the body.

ex.en: In the movie, the cyborg had a robot arm.
ex.ko: 영화 속 사이보그는 로봇 팔을 가지고 있었다.

easy: Making you feel like giving up.

ex.en: Losing three games in a row was discouraging.
ex.ko: 세 경기 연속으로 지는 것은 기운 빠지는 일이었다.

easy: Playing the drums.

ex.en: His drumming is so loud the whole house shakes.
ex.ko: 그가 치는 드럼 소리가 너무 커서 온 집이 흔들린다.

easy: In a very easy way, as if it took no work.

ex.en: The cat jumped effortlessly onto the high shelf.
ex.ko: 고양이는 높은 선반 위로 힘들이지 않고 뛰어올랐다.

easy: The years from 1980 to 1989.

ex.en: Grandma loved music from the eighties.
ex.ko: 할머니는 1980년대 음악을 좋아하셨다.

easy: To help someone understand something.

ex.en: Can you enlighten me about how this game works?
ex.ko: 이 게임이 어떻게 하는 건지 좀 알려줄래?

easy: Wrong or not correct.

ex.en: I got an erroneous answer because I added wrong.
ex.ko: 더하기를 잘못해서 틀린 답이 나왔다.

easy: Having to do with a family.

ex.en: Familial love made the house feel warm.
ex.ko: 가족 간의 사랑이 집을 따뜻하게 만들었다.

easy: A place where people catch fish and get them ready to sell.

ex.en: Dad's friend works at a fishery by the sea.
ex.ko: 아빠 친구는 바닷가 어장에서 일한다.

easy: Silly and not serious.

ex.en: It was a frivolous book full of silly jokes.
ex.ko: 그것은 우스운 농담이 가득한 가벼운 책이었다.
